functions.name: setBlockerGate
functions.description: Opens or closes the gate for the bundled blocker's own requests. Resolves to the gate's state as JSON.

functions.name: setEngineRequests
functions.description: What happens to the engine's own background requests: allow, log or block. Resolves to the gate's state as JSON.

events.name: onEvent
events.description: A request the gate acted on, as JSON: {k: 'blocker'|'engine'|'stopped', url, cancelled}.
